Venice Film Festival Awards Golden Lion to 'Woman Unknown'

The Golden Lion, the top prize at the Venice Film Festival, was awarded to May el-Toukhy's film 'Woman Unknown'. John Malkovich received the best actor award for his role in an unspecified film. The festival was described as politically charged. The awards ceremony concluded the event.
